summary: AngloGold Ashanti PLC furnished a Form 6-K covering its Q3 2026 earnings release investor presentation, dated 5 November 2026 and signed by Company Secretary C. Stead. The filing is a routine periodic earnings communication by a foreign private issuer, equivalent to a US quarterly earnings release/8-K earnings item; no transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, or board recommendation is disclosed. The exhibit is filed as Exhibit 99.1. No special-situation mechanics apply; watch only for ordinary operating and cost guidance updates rather than any deal-related catalyst.
